info.title: SendyKit API
info.description:
Canonical API contract for SendyKit v2.

Status tags on operations:
- x-status: live
- x-status: partial
- x-status: planned

Payment model:
- Stripe machine payments are the current machine-paid action mechanism.
- x402 compatibility is roadmap/future mode.
info.summary: Sendy-compatible email operations API with SendyKit exoskeleton, SaaS controls, readiness evaluation, and machine-paid premium actions.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for send/enroll/trigger endpoints. 24h dedupe window.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

EmailQuery.name: email
EmailQuery.description: Email address filter or lookup target.

SinceQuery.name: since
SinceQuery.description: Relative duration or RFC3339 timestamp, depending on endpoint.

Envelope.description: Standard SendyKit response wrapper. Most successful responses place the primary payload in `data` and optional metadata in `meta`.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error payload returned by SendyKit handlers.

AuthTokenRequest.description: Exchange an API key for a 24-hour JWT.

Brand.description: Sendy app/brand identity used for sender defaults and content scoping.

Subscriber.description: Subscriber record with Sendy-compatible status fields.

Campaign.description: Campaign record backed by Sendy campaign tables and SendyKit overlays.

Template.description: Email template object with HTML, plain text, and optional GrapeJS document.
